pamphlet_excerpts: Citizenship in the world means: The Declaration of Independence is a unique contract between citizens and government (p. 13).
Citizenship in the world means Principle 2: Governments are instituted among Men, deriving their just powers from the consent of the governed (p. 13).
Citizenship in the world means Principle 3: The right to a free trial, for example, obligates U. S. citizens to serve on juries (p. 13).
Citizenship in the world means Principle 4: The right to vote obligates them to be informed about important issues and the candidates' positions (p. 13).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Citizenship in the world means): Because the government rules with the consent of the citizens, Americans must understand and exercise their constitutional rights, or risk (p. 13).
Step 2 (Citizenship in the world means): In the United States, serving on a jury when called is a civic duty; it is also one way that the right to a free trial is protected (p. 13).
Step 3 (Citizenship in the world means): U. S. citizens live in an open society where it is safe to think outloud (p. 13).
Step 4 (Citizenship in the world means): We freely express our opinions, exchange ideas, and even disagree in public (p. 13).

quiz_item.scenario_prompt: In Citizenship in the World Requirement 1, how does national sovereignty interact with international law and diplomacy when countries address cross-border challenges?
quiz_item.question: In Citizenship in the World Requirement 1, how does national sovereignty interact with international law and diplomacy when countries address cross-border challenges?
options: A. A single world legislature automatically writes domestic criminal laws and collects income taxes inside every country.
B. Sovereign nations are legally prohibited from signing trade agreements, environmental treaties, or mutual defense pacts.
C. International law only applies to uninhabited islands and has no relevance to maritime shipping, aviation, or diplomatic embassies.

D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties, diplomatic agreements, and international organizations (such as the UN) to resolve disputes and cooperate on trade, security, and humanitarian aid.
choices: A. A single world legislature automatically writes domestic criminal laws and collects income taxes inside every country.
B. Sovereign nations are legally prohibited from signing trade agreements, environmental treaties, or mutual defense pacts.
C. International law only applies to uninhabited islands and has no relevance to maritime shipping, aviation, or diplomatic embassies.

D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties, diplomatic agreements, and international organizations (such as the UN) to resolve disputes and cooperate on trade, security, and humanitarian aid.
